angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 577,431 km at 159.55 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.2676 +/- 0.0139 mas (same row, RUWE 0.97): 159.55 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.83 +/- 0.04 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of CoRoT-7 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 577,431 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.82 +/- 0.17 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of CoRoT-7 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5275 +/- 75 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of CoRoT-7 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of CoRoT-7 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/corot-7.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.514, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of CoRoT-7 (pscomppars): spectral type G9 V, from John et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022MNRAS.515.3975J/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of CoRoT-7 (pscomppars): [M/H] 0.06 dex, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of CoRoT-7 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.28938, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of CoRoT-7 (pscomppars): age 1.8 Gyr, from John et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022MNRAS.515.3975J/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/other/RMxAA/56.139/corotd (On the evolution of angular momentum), column Per: 21.783 d, the row 0.2 arcsec from the star's J2000 place. The middle of 2 catalogued periods, 2 of them within 20% of it
